activePlan.objective: Two owner-requested follow-ups after a full CI diagnostic: (1) run CodeQL, AI handoff policy, the local suite, and lint/docs/audits directly on main, (2) something that permanently keeps PR #11 open no matter what.
steps: For (1): check codeql.yml, self-test.yml, and handoff-policy.yml's push triggers against main.

Find codeql.yml and self-test.yml already trigger on push: branches: [main, development] - only handoff-policy.yml was missing main from its push trigger (it only had push:development and pull_request:main, which fires before a merge, not on the resulting push to main).
Add main to handoff-policy.yml's push trigger.

For (2): design a safe, deterministic automation - reopen PR #11 immediately if closed without being merged (block-pr-7.yml's check cannot prevent a plain close). Do NOT auto-open a replacement or rewrite AGENTS.md if it is ever actually merged instead - that stays a human/attended-AI decision, per this repo's standing rule against invisible self-repair.
Add .github/workflows/guard-ci-monitor-pr.yml: pull_request:closed trigger, scoped to head.ref == 'ci-monitor' && merged == false, reopening via gh pr reopen.
Document both changes in AGENTS.md's PR #11 bullet; add matching test/workflow.test.js coverage for both.
Run the full local suite plus every fast/offline audit before pushing.

completed: handoff-policy.yml's push trigger is now branches: [development, main], so it verifies the DEVLOG/AI-HANDOFF handoff on the actual post-merge commit landing on main, not just the pre-merge PR diff.

Added .github/workflows/guard-ci-monitor-pr.yml: reopens PR #11 automatically the instant it's closed without being merged, scoped strictly to head branch ci-monitor so no other PR is ever touched. Explicitly does nothing if PR #11 is actually merged - no silent replacement PR or AGENTS.md rewrite.
AGENTS.md's PR #11 bullet now documents guard-ci-monitor-pr.yml and the human-in-the-loop boundary for the merged case.

Added two test/workflow.test.js updates: one asserting handoff-policy.yml's new push trigger, one new test asserting guard-ci-monitor-pr.yml's trigger/permissions/condition/command and the corresponding AGENTS.md text.
verification: lint:workflows, docs:check, validate, audit:clutter, audit:privacy, and audit:security all pass.
remaining: Push this commit to development, confirm Self-Test/CodeQL/AI handoff policy green, then fast-forward release to it so the next main promotion exercises handoff-policy.yml's new push:main trigger for real.

guard-ci-monitor-pr.yml has not yet been exercised live (no PR has been closed-without-merging since it was added) - worth a manual sanity check if the owner wants to verify it before trusting it fully.
The owner should confirm 'block' is added as a required status check on main (Settings -> Branches -> Branch protection rules) if not already done - no tool available here can do that remotely.

Still blocked on owner-supplied resources, not a code gap: the hosted multi-repository integration workflow and connect-workflow.yml's activate phase both need a real target repository/token to actually be exercised.
Codex's own remaining items still stand: no promotion or branch-protection change is authorized without the owner's explicit instruction beyond what's already been done.
